title: GST Vouchers' Offset of GST Paid by Lower-income Households
what_it_is: GST Vouchers' Offset of GST Paid by Lower-income Households

sections.label: GST Voucher offsets for households
sections.summary: From 2018 to 2020, permanent GSTV offsets averaged 84% of GST payable by the bottom 20% of Singaporean households, with 2019 and 2020 special payments adding a 33% offset.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: From 2018 to 2020, the permanent GSTV scheme offsets an average of 84% of the annual GST payable by the bottom 20% of Singaporean households, on a per household member basis.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The GSTV special payments in 2019 and 2020 were equivalent to an offset of 33% of the GST payable by the bottom 20% of Singaporean households, again, on a per household member basis.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This is on top of the 84% offset under the permanent scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In other words, in this extraordinary year, households in the bottom 20% got more from both the permanent and one-off GST Vouchers than the amount of GST payable.

sections.label: Studying permanent GST Voucher enhancements
sections.summary: The government is studying enhancements to the permanent GST Voucher, having committed to look at enhancing it when the GST rate was raised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: As to the enhancements to the permanent GST Voucher, that is something we are studying.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have committed; the Deputy Prime Minister did say when we talked about raising the GST rate, that we will also look at enhancing the permanent GST Voucher, not just providing a one-off offset but enhancing the permanent layer of the GST Voucher.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are studying that and will certainly get back with details when we are ready.
